description:
Clear the photos you don't need and find the ones you do, just by describing them. Roll's AI runs on your iPhone, so your photos, videos and the words you type never leave it.

FIND IT
Type the trip, like “Lisbon 2024”, and Roll finds it, grouped by day. Place and date words work: a city, a country, a month, a year, “christmas 2023”, “last summer”. Search for an activity like “soccer” or a thing like “receipts”: Roll reads the words in your screenshots too.

MAKE THE ALBUM
Tap Make album, pick from a grid, and Roll adds what you picked to an album in Photos. Turn on Keep this album updated and Roll shows you new photos that look like they belong. Nothing is added until you tap. Albums are free.

MORE LIKE THESE
Pick a few photos and Roll finds the rest.

CLEAR SPACE
Type what you want gone, like “receipts”, “whiteboard photos” or “memes from group chats”, and Roll gathers a pile for you. Swipe through it: keep or let go. Roll learns from your swipes. Apply the pile in one go: delete, move to an album, or squish. Deleted items go to Recently Deleted, so you can change your mind.

READY-MADE PILES
• Screenshots
• Blurry photos
• Big videos
• Duplicates and similar shots, grouped by moment

SQUISH
Re-save big photos and videos as smaller HEIC and HEVC copies and see about how much space you'll get back before you start. Videos stay at 1080p unless you choose to keep 4K.

MONITOR
Live readings of your iPhone's storage, battery and more. Read-only: Roll doesn't change how your phone runs.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Analysis and search run on your iPhone with an on-device AI model and Apple's on-device frameworks
• Place names come from a list built into Roll: your photos' locations are never looked up online
• No accounts, no analytics, no tracking
• Photos stored only in iCloud are downloaded from your own iCloud library only when you allow it

ROLL PRO: PAY ONCE
Search and albums are free, and so are your first 50 cleanups (deletes and squishes). Roll Pro is a single one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited cleanup. No subscription, nothing renews. Restore it anytime on your iPhone with the same Apple Account.

Terms of Use: https://roll.delavalom.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://roll.delavalom.com/privacy

whatsNew:
Find is here. Describe what you're looking for and Roll finds it, on your iPhone.

• Type a trip, a game or a holiday: “Lisbon 2024”, “soccer”, “christmas 2023”. Place and date words work.
• Answers come grouped by moment, so a trip reads day by day.
• Make album: pick from a grid and Roll adds only what you picked to an album in Photos.
• Keep this album updated: when new photos look like they belong, Roll shows them on Home. Nothing is added until you tap.
• More like these: pick a few photos and Roll finds the rest.
• When nothing clearly matches, Roll says so and shows the closest few.

Albums are free: adding photos to an album doesn't count toward your first 50 free changes.

Still private: search, place names and albums all happen on your iPhone. Place names come from a list built into Roll, so your locations are never looked up online.
